title: Who aventried the dear corse of our Agenbuyer, Healer and Herd
html_source:
“Aventre” is an
obsolete word of obscure meaning, though the
context of its use by Edmund Spenser suggests
“to thrust forward (at a venture) as a spear.”
“Corse” is obsolete for body: “Agenbuyer” is
Middle English for Christ, the Redeemer, as
“Herd” is Christ as shepherd of God’s flock,
mankind. – Gifford
